fusions.name: Eightfold Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out with 8 spread-out strikes, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ambush Grip
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage and is always a critical hit, leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ink Cloud
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reserve Arm
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
